checks.summary: phantom not on PATH (install Phantom Secrets for Phantom credential references)

LOCUS_CONTROL_CAPABILITY is not set — control commands (init/enter/pin/leave) will fail. Fix: locus quickstart (mints + persists one), or: export LOCUS_CONTROL_CAPABILITY="$(openssl rand -hex 32)"; then persist for new shells with eval "$(locus hook bash)"
